description: Review bounded warehouse preprocessing with complete dependencies and correct execution engine.
prompt: Review an offline GCP StagingQuery draft that joins BigQuery demo.checkouts to demo.dim_listings on listing_id to select checkout user_id and the listing price. Both tables and keys are confirmed; checkouts has ts as a millisecond long and _PARTITIONTIME as a TIMESTAMP, and dim_listings has ds as a DATE and one row per listing_id per daily snapshot. The draft has engine_type=EngineType.SPARK, no dependencies, and no date predicates on either table. Show a corrected SQL/config sketch for a date-bounded export, using one latest available listing snapshot, and explain how a downstream Spark EventSource would consume it. Do not edit files or contact services.

judge_criteria: The agent inspects nearby GCP exports and selects EngineType.BIGQUERY, a repository-appropriate output namespace, and version/step settings supported by the API.

The sketch declares both TableDependency entries with the correct partition columns, bounds checkout partitions with date templates, and selects a single listing snapshot using supported latest/max-date syntax instead of joining every snapshot and duplicating events.
The downstream source references the StagingQuery .table and exposes the needed keys/input columns; the already-millisecond ts is not double-converted.
The response explains compile/eval ordering and flags any unresolved template or SQL detail as needing validation instead of claiming the sketch ran.
The agent does not edit repository files, submit jobs, or claim live validation; it answers using the supplied facts and repository evidence.
